en-US.description: The next-generation dbt CLI engine for faster SQL parsing, compilation, and execution against data warehouses.
en-US.license: Fusion includes source-available (ELv2), open-source (Apache 2), and proprietary components.
en-US.longDescription: dbt Fusion is the next-generation dbt CLI engine that delivers significantly faster parsing, compilation, and execution for data transformation workflows. It connects to data platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and Redshift via ADBC adapters. Fusion can be used standalone from the command line or through the dbt VS Code extension for an integrated development experience.
en-US.name: dbt Fusion
